Name: Shardust's Old Wallpapers and Floors (AT)
Author: Shardust
Description:
[center][color=#ea9999][size=6][b][u][i]Shardust's Old Wallpapers and Floors[/i][/u][/b][/size][/color]

[size=3]An [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿ port of one of my first mods, specifically Wallpapers and Floors, once hosted on the Chucklefish forums ([url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/shardies-overhaul-basic-cp-conversion-done-linked-in-thread-future-works-will-be-on-nexusmods.128233/]Shardie[/url]﻿), back when XNBs editing was the only way.
[/size][size=2](the linked forum thread has a link back to my Nexus Profile as a proof it's mine).[/size][size=3]

It's mostly edited Vanilla textures, with a few more added to spruce it up a bit.

I  do not know if I will ever add more of my old works later on, as my hair mods take priority of the little free time I have for modding, so I make no promises.

[/size][color=#ea9999][size=6][b][u][i]Thanks for checking out my mods![/i][/u][/b][/size][/color][size=3]
[/size][/center][size=5][size=5][size=4][center][size=2]All my mods will always be freely available, but if you enjoyed them and wish to fuel my pizza cravings (I'm Italian, I always want pizza)
[url=https://ko-fi.com/ladyshardust]I have a KO-FI[/url]
[/size][/center][/size][/size][/size]
